scope.current_task: R9f edits preregistration/config and adds response only; static document/JSON checks and analytic arithmetic only; no data reread, random generation or experiment
forbidden_current_actions: read target CSV or any y-derived data except disclosed historical report summaries
read any round-8 per-sample predictions or lab/cases/magnet8/first*/ artifacts
generate random splits, S0 lists or acquisition sequences
write experiment code or run experiments
network access, pip install, git commit, git push
scope.acquisition: A only; no M or R acquisition arms
scope.baseline: B: rerun R8 E2-A model/acquisition/global scalar q with R9 seeds and split; no historical predictions, q, labels or model cache reused
scope.inference_scope: Randomization variability conditional on fixed N87 data and one family split; not independent measurements or new material replication
scope.claim_scope: H1/H2 test relative paired 90-percent coverage-shortfall reduction; A/J are descriptive absolute-coverage criteria without type-I-error control or population coverage guarantee. Confirmatory object is the complete D strategy; no center-only attribution or exclusion of width-only improvement.

data.hash_provenance: features/model/family source hashes verified in R9p; target CSV and B.npy hashes inherited from R8 config without opening or rehashing those files; R9f inherits all hashes and counts without rereading data or model source
label_access_order: after user approval and prereg commit binding: freeze input-only split, S0 and implementation; complete all input preflight checks before any label access or fit; archive infeasible_design_abort without redraw if failed
training: read only local S0 and queried pool labels; complete and seal all 60 trajectories, b=0..6 main models, final shadow models and deltas
calibration: reveal CAL9 only to compute predefined q values; never estimate delta, fit, select or stop
seal q and all evaluation interval predictions
isolated evaluation: reveal G9/XF/XT/XFT labels; no feedback to training/calibration
seal first evaluation; independent recomputation and reviewer_b review
data.sharing: B/E/D share their own (s,k) queried labels/trajectory/model; each shadow fit gets only its local core subset. No cross-k, cross-U/S or historical label/model/hyperparameter cache even for overlapping IDs.

family_definition.construction_scope: all input rows before restricting regions
family_definition.frequency_clustering: sorted unique frequency_Hz; new cluster when natural log(f_i/f_previous)>0.01

split.rows: support rows only in selected families; same-family T=90 remains XT
split.pool_formula: P = S minus G9 minus CAL9
split.actual_G_CAL_pool_counts: undetermined until prereg commit binding; do not substitute R8 counts

design.pairing: same k and U trajectory for every formal D-vs-B contrast; do not pool U/S or methods as independent repeats
design.S: first quota IDs in each stratum according to relative order in the same pi_k; union has 100 IDs
design.sampling: within trajectory without replacement; overlap across k and U/S allowed; common order couples U/S and independent seed streams separate k

model.reuse_rule: future isolated R9 adapter; do not mutate old files or use old evaluation_frame/fixed_sequence/signflip; set R9 GP seed and shadow-only input-based T_C^2 deletion; retain all main-model rules
model.scaler: StandardScaler fitted on this model's own training subset only
model.refit: from scratch each batch, final model and each shadow model; no warm starts or shared fitted scaler/hyperparameters
model.temperature_shadow_rank_deficiency: R9f removes structural 1,T,T^2 dependence in two-temperature shadow by dropping T^2; other collinearity may remain. Report actual features, rank, condition number and temperature levels; retain lstsq for other deficiencies; no post-result model changes; XT failure is not physical impossibility.
model.linear_features_scope: main model at every checkpoint and default shadow model; shadow-only exception below

shadow_linear_feature_rule.condition: if and only if number of unique training-subset T_C values < 3, drop T_C^2 from shadow OLS design
shadow_linear_feature_rule.precondition: first enforce required core temperature levels; this rule never excuses an invalid subset

acquisition.candidates: P minus local already queried IDs
acquisition.within_batch: freeze hyperparameters and y normalization; Cholesky believer updates as frozen model library
acquisition.label_reveal: fit 100+20*b queried points for b=0..5; select entire next batch of 20 before revealing its labels; final fit b=6 on 220 points
acquisition.shared: B/E/D use exactly the same local acquired T and final model

pseudo_extrapolation.construction_scope: support S only; deterministic input masks, never true holdout labels
pseudo_extrapolation.shadow_fit: M_j trained only on T intersect core_j; outputs mu_j,sigma_j; exclude T intersect edge_j from all fitting/scaling; final main model still uses all T
pseudo_extrapolation.delta_source: T intersect edge_j; queried training labels only, no CAL or evaluation labels
pseudo_extrapolation.delta_formula: delta_j=median(y_i-mu_j(x_i) for i in T intersect edge_j)
pseudo_extrapolation.median_even_rule: arithmetic mean of middle two ordered values
pseudo_extrapolation.transfer: shadow standardized residual quantiles transferred to main-model sigma in real target region; empirical hypothesis without coverage guarantee

intervals.width_monotonicity: D width >= B width pointwise and per arm because qD>=q0 and main sigma shared; equality on G9; also holds on XFT. For q0>0 single-direction width ratio=qD_j/q0, otherwise ratio undefined. Center shifts need not improve coverage.

seeds.H: int(first 8 hexadecimal characters of the prereg commit SHA,16)
seeds.rng: numpy.random.default_rng(seed), PCG64; independently initialized per role/k; pin NumPy version
seeds.design_seed_integer_policy: full Python integer; no modulus or uint32 conversion
seeds.intentional_sharing: same GP seed for all treatments, k, batches and shadow fits; same S0 permutation for U/S and same trajectory for B/E/D
seeds.nonoverlap_proof: R9 design seeds>=2**96, all R8 E1/E2 design seeds<2**65 and R6/R7 seeds<2**32; R9 GP reserved range excludes all actual R6/R7/R8 design and GP seeds
seeds.post_commit_check: explicit historical and new integer seed sets must have empty intersection; list intentional within-R9 reuse separately

metrics.g: max(0,0.90-c), computed per arm before averaging
metrics.weighting: equal rows within region; equal 30 pairs; no pooling XF/XT/XFT

hypotheses.sentence: D相对B在XF的90%覆盖欠缺配对差期望为正：E[g_B,XF−g_D,XF]>0。
D相对B在XT的90%覆盖欠缺配对差期望为正：E[g_B,XT−g_D,XT]>0。

tests.arithmetic_contract: d and epsilon are sealed binary64 inputs interpreted as exact binary rationals; convert to common power-of-two denominator, use arbitrary-precision integer sums/comparisons; no rounding of d
tests.implementation: exact MITM with two 2**15 signed-sum lists and inclusive integer threshold count; exact 2**K enumeration only as oracle, no 2**30 allocation
tests.reject_rule: p<0.025 and all preceding hypotheses within the same regional family formally rejected; equality is non-rejection
tests.stop_rule: each family starts if process_valid regardless of gates or other-family outcomes; first non-rejection stops only that family, second hypothesis not_tested with nominal p report-only; never resume or transfer alpha
tests.assumptions: independent paired seed repetitions conditional on fixed data/split; independent sign symmetry at zero boundary and symmetric location-shift model for composite mean null. Applies to shifted NI differences 1.10*W_B-W_D, not D/B label exchangeability; 1.10 scaling and 20-fold Winkler miss penalties can cause skew/heavy tails even with mean zero. Discrete truncated shortfalls can also violate symmetry.
tests.fwer_scope: strong FWER<=0.025 in each fixed regional sequence and <=0.05 overall by union bound, only conditional on valid p values under stated assumptions; no cross-region independence needed; exact counting and descriptive sensitivity do not establish validity
tests.coverage_interpretation: relative 90-percent shortfall superiority, not proof of absolute honesty or center-only benefit; overcoverage above 90 percent is truncated; every confirmatory result must also list A, WIDTH, J and both regional test statuses

gates.scope: separately for every s,m and Z=XF/XT; confirmatory conclusions only U,D
gates.HONEST90_method: at least 26/30 nominal90 per-arm passes, coverage only
gates.MEAN90: equal-pair mean c>=0.9, evaluated using integer sum of counts

WIDTH.comparison: direct <= multiplier*baseline, no division; zero baseline only passes for zero candidate width; no post-gate q/center adjustment
WIDTH.interpretation: hard cost budget; a single pair above 2.00 fails even if the mean passes; extreme failure risk, no 29/30 exception; D>=B structurally so only upper bounds needed

gates.A: V80 and HONEST90 and MEAN90 and FLOOR80
gates.interpretation: empirical finite-panel criteria without type-I-error control, not confidence bounds or population coverage guarantee; WIDTH and Winkler cannot exclude coverage gains entirely due to widening; MEAN90 alone can mask individual collapse, hence FLOOR80
gates.integer_ceiling_contract: ceil_div(a,b)=(a+b-1)//b for nonnegative integer a and positive integer b; use integer arithmetic throughout

FLOOR80.failure: any one support or target-region coverage below 80 percent fails A; mean coverage cannot compensate; does not require all arms to reach 90 percent

input_preflight: all frozen input totals, unique IDs, families, temperatures and frequency setpoints match
S/XF/XT/XFT disjoint and exhaustive; G9/CAL9/P family-disjoint within support
all six P strata have at least their S0 quota
each CAL9 intersect pseudo-edge has at least 20 rows and 2 families
validity.model_validity: all fits complete and all predictions, sigmas, deltas, q and differences finite; enforce required core temperatures and shadow feature rule; any remaining rank deficiency is reported but not alone failure
validity.process: all 60 trajectories and 180 interval arms complete, all formal tests have 30 pairs, exact budgets and label permissions audited, source/model/config/seed hashes and acquisition replay pass
validity.failure_policy: any planned U or S trajectory failure => incomplete round, no confirmatory conclusions; no drop/replacement/redraw/boundary change/budget addition; only logged infrastructure retry with identical seed/config/state

conclusions.both: only SUCCESS_F and SUCCESS_T together support both-direction relative shortfall improvement and 10-percent Winkler NI for the complete D strategy, conditional on test assumptions, with A/WIDTH/J all passed
conclusions.one: only name the successful direction; either region can succeed without any rejection in the other family; no extrapolation-wide success claim

exhaustive_region_hierarchy.interpretation: full empirical coverage standard not met; list failed V80/HONEST90/MEAN90/FLOOR80; a rejected coverage test only means smaller shortfall

exhaustive_region_hierarchy.when: process_valid and A and not WIDTH
exhaustive_region_hierarchy.interpretation: coverage criteria met but width cost exceeded

exhaustive_region_hierarchy.when: process_valid and J and coverage hypothesis not formally rejected
exhaustive_region_hierarchy.interpretation: empirical criteria met but relative shortfall improvement unconfirmed; distinguish not_rejected/not_tested

exhaustive_region_hierarchy.when: process_valid and J and coverage hypothesis formally rejected and Winkler hypothesis not formally rejected
exhaustive_region_hierarchy.interpretation: coverage shortfall improved and criteria met; 10 percent score noninferiority unconfirmed

exhaustive_region_hierarchy.when: process_valid and J and both regional hypotheses formally rejected
exhaustive_region_hierarchy.interpretation: regional SUCCESS for complete D under fixed-panel and conditional inference limits; list A/WIDTH/J and both formal statuses

conclusions.special_cases: B may also pass empirical standards; both A passing does not imply all g zero. E/S are descriptive only. Non-rejection does not establish equivalence/inferiority/ineffectiveness. Neither regional family blocks the other. No post-hoc method promotion, alpha transfer or pure-center claim.
prohibited_claims: gates have type-I-error control or population 90-percent guarantee
D/B success proves center correction caused improvement
WIDTH or Winkler excludes width-only explanation
XT failure proves physical extrapolation impossible

dual_honesty_exit.when: process_valid and A(U,B,Z) and A(U,D,Z) and coverage hypothesis not formally rejected
dual_honesty_exit.report: 基线与候选方法均达到预注册经验覆盖标准，相对欠覆盖改进未确认。
dual_honesty_exit.required: list WIDTH/J and Winkler not_tested status; retain width-cost-exceeded conclusion if applicable; never call D a failed method on this basis
dual_honesty_exit.counts: report each method nonzero-g arm count, mean g and d positive/zero/negative counts
dual_honesty_exit.only_if_all_zero: if every g_B and g_D equals zero, d=0 and p=1; add 本评估面板无额外相对欠覆盖需要缩减
dual_honesty_exit.equal_nonzero: d all zero with common nonzero g only means equal shortfalls, not absence of shortfalls

s0_report_only.zero_variance: v_U==0 => ratio/reduction null, criterion not_evaluable; no epsilon substitution
s0_report_only.both_direction_support: both region rules pass; otherwise report each region separately

variance_decomposition.matrix: U treatment coverage z_km with k=1..30 and m=B,E,D, separately XF/XT
variance_decomposition.limitation: no within-cell repetition; interaction and residual cannot be separated

s0_report_only.interpretation: S0-policy plus downstream acquisition total effect; no isolation of pure S0 from its mediated sampling effect, no retrospective causal proof about R8

report_only: all s,m,k,regions final c/g/w/W, coverage counts, nominal90 shortfall, MAE, bias, median relative error and gate components; full per-arm minima/maxima
all q0/qE/qD/delta, shadow/core/edge/calibration counts and families, actual design matrix feature columns/ranks/condition numbers and temperature levels
prespecified D/E paired contrasts, both equal-width center diagnostics and all S outputs; never promote to confirmatory
XFT scores and distributions only, no pass/fail or formal test
each hypothesis d mean/median/IQR and positive/zero/negative counts; nominal p with its regional fixed-sequence status
sampling by fset, temperature and 8 equal-width bins of v=log10(4*f*Bpk) over entire P; clip(floor(8*(v-lo)/(hi-lo)),0,7), require hi>lo; S0 separated from additions
realized pool/training extrema; validity_pass_counts separate from sampling_counts
S0 variance policy contrast, decomposition and prespecified descriptive support flags; no extra formal hypotheses
U-only Winkler ratios and all 30 leave-one-pair-out descriptive means; no bootstrap or alternate formal tests
both-A/zero-shortfall reporting clauses, FLOOR80 pass counts and any width single-pair veto

power_and_limits.caveat: analytic single-test normal approximation only, not exact sign-flip power or end-to-end power; old alpha=.05 powers .707/.950 superseded; actual joint power unknown and may be much lower
end_to_end_requirements: two rejections in the regional family
WIDTH all 30 and mean cap; both-direction success requires both regions
power_and_limits.joint_probability_bound: intersection probability <= minimum required marginal probability; product requires independence and is not a general upper bound

HONEST90_binomial_example.interpretation: arm pass probability is not population coverage; no inference that true coverage must be 93 percent

power_and_limits.extreme_gate_risk: WIDTH remains all 30; a single 2.01x pair fails; FLOOR80 also requires all 30; no relaxation for power

preflight_risk.interpretation: combinatorial uniform-family-permutation reference before binding; other input failures can add risk; after binding never redraw or replace SHA; conditional power is not unconditional success probability

limitations: single reused N87 dataset and one family split
two-temperature linear extrapolation and remaining collinearity
asymmetric shifted Winkler and truncated-shortfall differences may invalidate inference
input-only infeasibility must be archived before training
bounded width does not exclude width-only coverage improvement

C03_future_implementation_requirements.do_not_modify: scripts/magnet8_evaluate.py or any round 1 through 8 file
C03_future_implementation_requirements.remove: no copied/called K<=14 legacy floating-point correction branch; no old magnet6 signflip
C03_future_implementation_requirements.retain: one exact enumeration/MITM arithmetic contract for all validation K; formal entry requires K=30
unit_tests_before_real_labels: K=1..14 plus 15 and 16 synthetic vectors: MITM integer numerator equals independent exhaustive 2**K oracle
all zeros p=1; K=30 and every d_k=1.0 has numerator=1; all negatives p=1
duplicates, mixed signs, exact ties, zeros with 2**z multiplicity, small/large scales
exact and either-side epsilon threshold examples using binary-rational integer arithmetic; no float reassociation exceptions
reject NaN/Inf/wrong shapes and formal K!=30
p==0.025 non-rejection; each regional sequence stops and never resumes; XF failure permits XT success and conversely; no alpha recycling
integer coverage ceilings, Q90 finite rank, bias correction sign, zero width baseline, zero S0 variance
shadow edge labels excluded from shadow fit; CAL excluded from delta; true holdouts excluded from all calibration
FLOOR80 single-arm veto and dual-A reporting with nonzero vs all-zero shortfalls
shadow 2/3-temperature levels drop/retain T_C^2; main model always retains it
both equal-width diagnostic anchors and Winkler zero-denominator/leave-one-pair-out descriptions
C03_future_implementation_requirements.independent_recompute: rebuild integer p numerators, metrics, validity_pass_counts, every gate and conclusions; decimal p agreement alone insufficient

execution.launch: nohup setsid; watchdog outside paused worker process groups

watchdog.hysteresis: between thresholds or at equality retain state
watchdog.action: stop dispatch and pause workers below low threshold; resume above high threshold; pausing does not reclaim memory; persistent low memory/OOM => logged infrastructure stop, identical seed/config/state resume; no threshold/data/model changes

infeasible_design_abort.trigger: any input preflight count/stratum assertion failure
infeasible_design_abort.timing: before any training/calibration/evaluation label access or model fit
infeasible_design_abort.researcher_action: stop immediately, status=infeasible_design_abort; incomplete round, no confirmatory conclusions
moderator_archive: first failure manifest and status log
prohibited: reclassify design failure as infrastructure failure
infeasible_design_abort.redesign: requires a separate future preregistration retaining this aborted design record

execution.equal_width_diagnostics: isolated evaluation scores only; no added fits, trajectories or formal method arms

freeze.commit_rule: first commit containing all three effective reviewed documents/config after user approval, before any R9 random generation/training/calibration; moderator commits in a separately authorized later task
manifest: sorted IDs, families, common permutations, U/S S0s, pseudo masks/counts and hashes
freeze.conflict_rule: stop before labels if prereg/config/input assertions conflict; do not choose favorable interpretation
post_results_immutable: descriptive diagnostic anchors and reporting rules
freeze.revision_policy: record all available reviewer_b/reviewer_c comments and source truncation; preserve all pre-result revisions; frozen changes require a new future preregistration, not retroactive success
freeze.self_hash_policy: two prereg/config SHA256 values in R9f handoff; all three deliverable hashes in later manifest; no circular self hashes

reviewer_c.truncation: R9-C02 ends mid-sentence at δ 与 q 在 CAL 上有; opening summary also addressed; no claim about unseen comments

ablation_report_only.interpretation: D/E total change combines center shift and recalculated q; not pure center attribution

equal_width_diagnostics.intervals: compare [mu+delta_j-q*sigma,mu+delta_j+q*sigma] with [mu-q*sigma,mu+q*sigma] using sealed main mu/sigma and sealed delta/q
equal_width_diagnostics.g_rule: truncate shortfall per arm before differencing or averaging
equal_width_diagnostics.summaries: same all-30-values/mean/median/min/max/sign-count summaries at each anchor; report both, no selection
equal_width_diagnostics.phase: isolated evaluation after all predictions and q sealed; no feedback to calibration
equal_width_diagnostics.no_center_improvement: explicitly report absence of equal-width center improvement where diagnostic does not improve
equal_width_diagnostics.interpretation: panel-specific description only; no population causal proof and cannot exclude width-only D/B improvement

winkler_sensitivity_report_only.per_pair_ratios: W_D/W_B for all pairs; null if W_B==0; no epsilon and no removal from formal test
winkler_sensitivity_report_only.leave_one_pair_out: for k=1..30 report mean(1.10*W_B-W_D) on other 29 pairs, all 30 values, min, max and nonpositive count
winkler_sensitivity_report_only.bootstrap_omission_reason: geometric/mean per-pair ratio is a different estimand from expected score difference; ordinary paired bootstrap cannot validate sign symmetry or original FWER; deterministic descriptions are not a robustness proof
